review.note: The point is the P625 of Wikidata Q15231507, the Battle of In-Delimane (2012), read on 2026-09-25 — A9's first step as A12 (2) corrects it, and not the item's P276, which is the town of Ansongo a degree of longitude west. The village has no item this pass could reach; the article at revision 1370443727 calls it "the village of Idelimane 80 kilometers from Ménaka" and its own title spells it In-Delimane, so both names are kept.
